units: Ber. I, 3, sq. בָּעֶ׳ in the evening (at prayer); a. v. fr.—Trnsf. decline.
Gen. R. s. 50 בָּעֶרֶב בָּא עַרְבָהּ של סדום baʿereb (Gen. XIX, 1), the evening of Sodom has come. Esth. R. introd. מי יתן ערבה, v. בֹּקֶר; a. fr.

senses.gloss: entrance, the day preceding a certain day, the year preceding a certain period, eve.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:7">Sabb. II, 7</cite> <he>ע׳ שבת</he> (abbrev. <he>ע״ש</he>) on Friday.
<cite ref="Pesachim 99b:2">Pes. 99ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ הפסח</he> the eve of the Passover.
<cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 4:7">Taan. IV, 7</cite> <he>ע׳ תשעה באב</he> the day preceding the ninth of Ab.
Shebi. I, 1 ע׳ שביעית the year preceding the Sabbatical year; a. v. fr.—Du. עַרְבַּיִם.
Ber. 26ᵇ, a. fr. בין הע׳ the time between the beginning of the decline of the sun and sunset (v. מִנְחָה), afternoon.—Pl. עֲרָבִים, constr. עַרְבֵי.
<cite ref="Berakhot 12a:24">Ber. 12ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="P01244"><he>עָרַב</he> II</cite>. [<cite ref="P01280"><he>עֲרָבִין</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="P01284"><he>עַרְבִית</he></cite>.]—

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:1">Pes. X, 1</cite> <he>ערבי פסחים</he> (Bab. ed. 99ᵇ <he>ערב</he>, Ms. M. <he>ערבי</he>). Ib. 99ᵇ <he>ע׳ שבתות וימים טובים</he> the eves of Sabbaths and Festivals; a. v. fr.
